name: cellobiose to mycothione
summary: A 9-step route from cellobiose to mycothione, ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: L-cysteine--[L-cysteinyl-carrier protein] ligase
reactions.equation: holo-[peptidyl-carrier protein] + L-cysteine + ATP = L-cysteinyl-[peptidyl-carrier protein] + AMP + diphosphate
